Although it may seem unusual at first, it is definitely worth trying.

I had a great experience at Ech Xanh Restaurant. The frog dishes were very tasty and well-seasoned, especially the fried frog and stir-fried frog with lemongrass and chili. The meat was fresh, tender, and not fishy at all. Portions were generous and suitable for sharing. The staff were friendly and the service was quite fast. The restaurant has a casual, local atmosphere, making it a good place for family meals or gatherings with friends. Prices are reasonable for the quality of food. Overall, Ech Xanh is a great choice if you enjoy frog dishes.
